categories.rationale: Prevents ephemeral-port collision failures on BSD platforms in functional test HTTP clients. Author identified that on FreeBSD and OpenBSD, overlapping port ranges caused clients targeting closed ports to self-connect, which was discovered while stress-testing FreeBSD CI in #36147.
